{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float
# Remove commas and convert to float
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check the first few rows after conversion
print(sales_df[['revenue', 'channel']].head())

# Check total revenue by channel
revenue_by_channel = sales_df.groupby('channel')['revenue'].sum()
print('\nTotal revenue by channel:\n', revenue_by_channel)

# Check if refunded orders are included
refunded_revenue = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'refunded']['revenue'].sum()
print('\nTotal revenue from refunded orders:', refunded_revenue)"}
